Review: Marketing Analytics & MTDI
I’ll be leaving NSU soon with a double major in Marketing and MIS and before that, I wanna share a few genuine faculty and course reviews. 
Would start it with MKT475 (Marketing Analytics).
I am(was) one of those people who consider marketing major to be a subject of common sense, and hands down to MKT475 and MTDI for breaking that thought bubble and actually challenging me 
See more

I’m majoring in Finance. I pursued MKT 475 course as my free elective and honestly I have no regrets at all. This course was very informative, super fun and I learned so many things from it.
Also MTDI teaches really good. Literally loved his classes.

I wish NSU offered this course when I was still enrolled. Sounds like a legitimate course for people who want to persue the analytical side of business while still staying in the marketing field. And MTDI sir is definitely the best and most perfect instructor for this course
MTDI sir is truly one of a kind. Makes me want to go back and do this course

tbm.review: Okay so I did Mkt 475 and Alhamdulillah ended up with an A-. If you think, you want to learn more about Analytics like R programming, summarizing data, histogram then analytics will help you to learn more. The lab classes were well designed according to me because we were the first batch and our faculty (TBM miss) said that the outline will be more precised in near future. TBM miss was so helpful and she tried a lot so that we can learn atleast something. Online e ei course ta na neya better because it's all about practical work. Without lab, you will not get to know what marketing analytics is about. Those who want to pursue their careers on Analytics, I must say enroll this course. Because after 10 years, analytics er uporei sob kichu Hobe. Banglalink already analytics niye kaaj shuru korse and TBM miss arranged a session with some experts from Banglalink with all of her sections.
Shagufta Sheherzad Haque Onek beshi kotha bole. shoja kothay bolte beshi dream dekhay. but marks motamoti valoi dey. questions ektu tricky kore.
Mkt475 is taking TBM and she is a sweetheart
